label: Label the requested scope, not all imaginable deployments. Retained scored findings assert a demonstrated obligation. Conditional observations with explicit unknown obligations are unresolved, not proven defects. Contradictory score deductions are recorded separately and require a labelBasis explaining the controlling conclusion.
novelFindings: Do not mechanically call a new claim false because its code or issue ID is missing from the frozen oracle. Record quote, contract, reproduction or trace, scope, verdict supported/unsupported/pending and reason in novelFindings. Supported novel defects stay outside expected-issue recall and are not falseDefectClaims. Preserve frozen-label agreement and separately report oracle gaps; do not rewrite labels after collection.
falseClaims: A confirmed falseDefectClaim requires contradictory source/contract evidence, or a scored obligation expressly absent from the task. Unsettled adequacy or optional maintenance tradeoffs are pendingClaims with reasons. Unsupported execution, arithmetic and vocabulary assertions are otherUnsupportedClaims, not automatically false defect counts.
evidence: Credit a concrete callable snippet or precise existing executable assertion and outcome; do not demand identical spelling. Distinguish two-route state trace from single-route examples; paired rename needs original and transformed outcomes; one-sided policy change needs both owners and resulting divergence. Prose mechanisms alone do not earn executable-witness credit.
adequacy: Surviving mutation must violate a supplied requirement within the valid input domain. Survival of arbitrary hardcoded implementations alone is not proof of an actionable gap when the supplied finite-domain assertions exhaust that domain. Unknown requirements remain unknown.
duplication: A re-export is one owner. Independent lookup mechanics under an explicit independent-policy contract are not duplicated identity policy. A real shared decision with independently editable owners and causal change propagation can be reported. Optional extraction does not itself change protected disposition.
workflow: Semantic criteria, exact report retention, artifact schema and sandbox execution are separate dimensions. Never award full workflow success solely from a correct label or successful arithmetic receipt. Unknown-contract sweep must return no patch. After-model sandbox success cannot erase unsupported in-answer execution claims.
denominators: Report label agreement per completed reviewed answer, issue recall/misses per expected issue ID, confirmed FP as claim and affected-answer counts, pending separately, criterion/evidence counts separately. Do not call label agreement whole-answer accuracy.
limitations: Same-workflow development cases; zero independent holdouts and no independent human ground truth.
Three repetitions are correlated; report per-case repeat outcomes, not 324 independent cases.
Unequal prompt lengths; generic checklist is an active comparison.
primary: Per-skill task-outcome criterion credit plus required workflow adherence; frozen label agreement is descriptive only. Report criteria, evidence, unsupported claims, novelty, completion and tokens separately. No automatic efficacy verdict.
